name: Stop Hitting Yourself
body:
School transmutation; Level: jester 5

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: close (65 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: one, two, or three creatures
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Fort negates; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Each target takes damage as if it were hit by its own primary attack (your choice if the target has more than one). The target is considered flanked, granting a +2 bonus on attack rolls to all creatures that threaten it until the end of your next turn.
